svg.aria-label: dsh-essay-rubric-check structure: a rubric sheet whose student cell and two criterion rows carry five numbered pins, and whose rule pack carries the sixth; each pin opens one finding card with rule, severity, scope and a row + column locator; the report band keeps issues and skipped apart and leaves the verdict to the reviewer
